"LA ESPADA CELESTIAL
ENCARGO MAESTRO DEFINITIVO PARA IA GAME LAB
RPG DE FANTASÍA ÉPICA — OBJETIVO: ASPIRAR A GOTY
INSTRUCCIÓN PRINCIPAL:
Quiero que desarrolles LA ESPADA CELESTIAL, un videojuego RPG de fantasía medieval, acción, aventura, exploración y criaturas coleccionables. No quiero una simple demostración, una maqueta, una presentación, una biblia de diseño ni un escenario con botones decorativos. Quiero un videojuego real, jugable, funcional, profundo, original y profesional.
La ambición es crear un título capaz de competir algún día entre los mejores videojuegos del mundo y aspirar al premio GOTY (Game of the Year).
No afirmes que el juego ha ganado o merece un premio sin haberlo conseguido. El GOTY es nuestro objetivo de excelencia, no una promesa.
Debes trabajar sobre las capacidades reales de IA Game Lab, inspeccionar el proyecto existente y utilizar las herramientas disponibles para construir el juego. No inventes funciones que la plataforma no pueda ejecutar. Si algo no es posible, explica la limitación y desarrolla la mejor alternativa técnica.
---
1. IDENTIDAD DEL VIDEOJUEGO
Nombre: LA ESPADA CELESTIAL.
Género: RPG de acción, fantasía medieval, aventura, exploración, combate y colección de criaturas.
Plataforma prioritaria: Android.
Orientación: Horizontal.
Idioma: Español de España.
Estética: Fantasía medieval cinematográfica con personalidad anime, escenarios detallados, iluminación espectacular, personajes originales y efectos visuales de alta calidad.
Inspiración: La profundidad de los grandes RPG, la libertad de exploración de las aventuras clásicas y la emoción de coleccionar criaturas, sin copiar personajes, diseños, música, historias ni propiedades intelectuales existentes.
El juego debe tener identidad propia y ser reconocible por su universo, personajes, criaturas, música y dirección artística.
---
2. OBJETIVO DE CALIDAD: NIVEL GOTY
Diseña y desarrolla el juego siguiendo estándares de excelencia en:
Jugabilidad.
Combate.
Historia.
Personajes.
Mundo.
Exploración.
Diseño artístico.
Música y sonido.
Animaciones.
Inteligencia artificial.
Interfaz y controles.
Rendimiento.
Accesibilidad.
Profundidad de sistemas.
Originalidad.
Cada sistema debe aportar algo al conjunto.
No quiero cantidad sin calidad.
No quiero un mundo enorme vacío, enemigos repetidos, misiones genéricas ni habilidades que no tengan utilidad.
Quiero una experiencia memorable.
---
3. UNIVERSO E HISTORIA
El mundo está formado por regiones conectadas por una historia épica.
Región inicial: VALDORIA
Una tierra de aldeas, bosques, praderas, ríos, montañas, ruinas y antiguas civilizaciones.
Aquí comienza la aventura.
Región de DRAKMOR
Territorios volcánicos, fortalezas, ciudades devastadas, bosques oscuros y criaturas corrompidas.
Región de KANSORDORE
Templos celestiales, ciudades antiguas, bibliotecas prohibidas, dimensiones alternativas y misterios relacionados con el origen del mundo.
Elementos fundamentales de la historia
La Gema Celestial.
La Jarra de Origen.
La Lágrima de la Primera Brasa.
La Profecía de Jugador Cero.
La Convergencia Absoluta.
El Despertar.
La Resonancia.
El Velo.
La Ruptura.
La Ascensión.
Construye una historia original, coherente y emocionante, con misterios, revelaciones, conflictos, decisiones, consecuencias, personajes memorables y un final satisfactorio.
No reveles todos los misterios al principio.
La historia debe desarrollarse mediante acontecimientos jugables, diálogos, exploración y escenas cinematográficas.
---
4. PROTAGONISTA
Crear un protagonista personalizable.
Permitir configurar, según las posibilidades técnicas:
Nombre.
Rostro.
Pelo.
Color de pelo.
Ropa.
Armadura.
Casco.
Accesorios.
Armas.
Estadísticas
Vida.
Maná.
Resistencia.
Fuerza.
Defensa.
Velocidad.
Inteligencia.
Suerte.
Cada atributo debe tener efectos medibles.
El equipamiento debe modificar las estadísticas y, cuando sea viable, la apariencia del personaje.
Crear animaciones diferenciadas de reposo, caminar, correr, atacar, esquivar, bloquear, recibi
"

# 🤯 OMG — Oh My GitHub ### 🚀 One Prompt In. A Full Game or App Out. 🚀 [![Status](https://img.shields.io/badge/status-🔥%20works-brightgreen?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/denaidark/OhMyGithub/actions) [![GitHub Issues](https://img.shields.io/github/issues/denaidark/OhMyGithub?style=for-the-badge&logo=github)](https://github.com/denaidark/OhMyGithub/issues) [![GitHub Actions](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub%20Actions-automated-2088FF?style=for-the-badge&logo=githubactions&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/denaidark/OhMyGithub/actions) [![OpenCode](https://img.shields.io/badge/powered%20by-OpenCode-111111?style=for-the-badge)](https://opencode.ai/) ```text ╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗ ║ DESCRIBE IT → BUILD IT → TEST IT → PLAY IT ║ ║ ║ ║ One GitHub issue. One prompt. A complete project. ║ ╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝ ``` **No API keys to configure. No server to maintain. No local setup maze.**
--- ## 🤯 What Is OMG? > **Your GitHub issue becomes the product brief.** OMG (Oh My GitHub) is an automated GitHub Actions workflow for creating complete browser games and app projects from one natural-language prompt. Write what you want in an issue and add the `OpenCode` label. OpenCode checks out the project, uses the shared skills, builds the experience, runs tests, verifies the result, and publishes an immutable OmGithub project link from the finished commit. Yes, it creates the code. Yes, it runs the verification loop. Yes, it can expose the result in a temporary browser URL. ## 🧠 TL;DR 1. Open a GitHub issue. 2. Describe the game or app you want. 3. Add the `OpenCode` label to the issue. 4. Let GitHub Actions build, test, verify, and propose the result. ```text Your idea → GitHub issue → OpenCode → tests → immutable OmGithub project ``` ## ⚡ Quick Start Create an issue in your repository with a concrete request: ```text Build a neon asteroid game. Requirements: - Arrow-key movement - Score and restart button - Win and lose states - Responsive browser layout - Run tests and verify it in a browser ``` That is the whole user-facing workflow. GitHub Actions handles the runner, OpenCode handles implementation, and the workflow handles verification plus the immutable project commit. To run against an existing non-default branch, end the issue title with a `branch: ` directive. The directive selects the checkout and is removed before the issue body is sent to OpenCode: ```sh gh issue create \ --repo denaidark/OhMyGithub \ --title "Custom branch smoke test branch: codex/omgithub-site" \ --body "Build a tiny browser page." \ --label Goal \ --label OpenCode ``` The GitHub App validates the branch before dispatching. If the directive is absent, the repository default branch remains the target. ## 🌍 What Can You Build? | 🎯 Use case | ✨ Example | |---|---| | 🎮 Arcade games | Breakout, Space Invaders, Asteroids, Match-3 | | 🧩 Puzzle games | Word games, logic puzzles, card games | | 🏃 Interactive demos | Physics experiments, simulations, visual toys | | 📊 Dashboards | Filters, charts, status panels, analytics views | | 🛠️ Internal tools | Trackers, generators, small workflow apps | | 🌐 Landing pages | Product pages, portfolios, interactive showcases | | 🧪 Prototypes | Turn a product idea into a runnable proof of concept | | 📱 Browser apps | Responsive tools that work on desktop and mobile | ## 🧰 What Happens Automatically? > **The workflow is the product.** - 📥 Checks out your repository and the shared OpenCode skills. - 🏷️ Synchronizes `model/*` and `skill/*` labels. - 🧭 Reads issue labels to select the model and requested skills. - 🤖 Runs OpenCode against the current project.

import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'
import { resolve, join, extname } from 'node:path'
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { createServer } from 'node:http'
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'
import { child } from './session-lifecycle.mjs'
import { livePreviewScript, watchProject } from './live-preview.mjs'

export function projectType(root) {
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'package.json'))) {
    const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))
    if (p.dependencies?.next || p.devDependencies?.next) throw new Error('Unsupported framework: customize start.sh and provide static deployment output.')
    if (p.dependencies?.vite || p.devDependencies?.vite) return 'vite'
    throw new Error('Unsupported package project: customize start.sh and deployment output.')
  }
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) return 'html'
  throw new Error('No generated index.html or supported package project.')
}
export async function start(root = process.cwd()) {
  const type = projectType(root)
  const projectRoot = resolve(root)
  if (type === 'vite') {
    const stampDir = process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR || join(root, 'node_modules', '.cache')
    mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
    const stamp = join(stampDir, 'default-dependencies')
    const lock = join(root, 'package-lock.json')
    const hash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
    let old = ''
    try { old = readFileSync(stamp, 'utf8') } catch {}
    if (old !== hash || !existsSync(join(root, 'node_modules/vite'))) {
      await child('npm', [existsSync(lock) ? 'ci' : 'install', '--no-audit', '--no-fund'], { cwd: root })
      mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
      const installedHash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
      writeFileSync(stamp, installedHash)
    }
    await child(process.execPath, [join(root, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './'], { cwd: root })
    root = join(root, 'dist')
  }
  if (!existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) throw new Error('Static deployment output must contain index.html.')
  if (process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR) writeFileSync(join(process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR, 'deployment-output.json'), JSON.stringify({ project: projectRoot, directory: resolve(root) }))
  const mime = { '.html':'text/html', '.js':'application/javascript', '.css':'text/css', '.json':'application/json', '.svg':'image/svg+xml', '.png':'image/png', '.jpg':'image/jpeg', '.webp':'image/webp', '.wasm':'application/wasm', '.glb':'model/gltf-binary' }
  const clients = new Set()
  const stopWatching = watchProject(root, () => { for (const client of clients) client.write('event: change\ndata: changed\n\n') })
  const keepAlive = setInterval(() => { for (const client of clients) client.write(': keepalive\n\n') }, 20000)
  const buildWatcher = type === 'vite' ? spawn(process.execPath, [join(projectRoot, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './', '--watch'], { cwd: projectRoot, stdio: 'inherit' }) : null
  const server = createServer((req, res) => {
    try {
      const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost')
      if (url.pathname === '/__omgithub/live') {
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream', 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache', 'X-Accel-Buffering': 'no', Connection: 'keep-alive' })
        res.write(': connected\n\n')
        clients.add(res)
        req.on('close', () => clients.delete(res))
        return
      }
      const path = resolve(root, '.' + decodeURIComponent(url.pathname))
      if (path !== resolve(root) && !path.startsWith(resolve(root) + '/')) { res.writeHead(404); res.end(); return }
      const file = statSync(path).isDirectory() ? join(path, 'index.html') : path
      res.setHeader('Content-Type', mime[extname(file)] || 'application/octet-stream')
      res.setHeader('Cache-Control', url.searchParams.has('omgithub_live') ? 'no-store' : 'no-cache')
      const content = readFileSync(file)
      if (extname(file) === '.html' && url.searchParams.get('omgithub_live') === '1') {
        const html = content.toString()
        res.end(/<\/body\s*>/i.test(html) ? html.replace(/<\/body\s*>/i, `${livePreviewScript}</body>`) : html + livePreviewScript)
      } else res.end(content)
    } catch { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not found') }
  })
  server.on('close', () => { stopWatching(); clearInterval(keepAlive); buildWatcher?.kill(); for (const client of clients) client.end() })
  server.listen(Number(process.env.PORT || 3000), '0.0.0.0')
  return server
}
if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href) await start()

Now append after ZONES: NPCs, quests, lore, cinematics, endings, world map, loot tables. Replace `// __PART3__\n};` with content. Let's plan length: NPC dialogues ~12k, quests ~8k, lore ~6k, cinematics ~8k, endings ~5k. Total 40k. Split into parts 3,4,5.

Part 3: NPCs + PORTRAIT maybe. Use effects.

Let's write NPCs carefully.

Helper functions not needed; each dialogue function returns object. Use `g` parameter.

Elara:
```js
export const NPCS = {
 elara: { name:'Maestra Elara', role:'...', portrait:'elara', dialogue(g){
   const m1 = g.questState('m1'), m2=...
   if (m1==='done' && !g.flags.nima_met) return {...};
   if (g.flags.gem_taken && !g.flags.m3_started) ...
   return first meeting
 }}
}
```
Game methods: `g.questState(id)`, `g.hasItem(id)`, `g.flags`. Use only those.

Dialogue shape:
```
{
  portrait:'elara', speaker:'Elara', role:'Maestra Resonadora',
  lines:[
    {text:'...'},
    ...
    {text:'...', choices:[...]},
    {text:'...', end:true}
  ],
  endEffect:{type:'elara_blessing'}
}
```
If a line has choices, the UI shows choices; after choosing, next index or end. If choice has `effect` then applies. If line has `end:true`, close after continue (and apply endEffect).
We'll implement: `advance()` on continue; if current line has choices, cannot continue; choose sets index = choice.next ?? index+1, applies effect. If line.end or last -> close. `endEffect` applies on close always? We need avoid applying when just flavor. We'll set endEffect only when needed. For first Elara, endEffect elara_blessing. But if player closes via Escape? UI can prevent. Fine.
Quest event talk called when dialogue opens by game.interact NPC. It will advance m1 step 0. Good.

Elara first dialogue must handle if m1 step 0. After close, endEffect gives sword/lumito. Quest tracker step 1 shrine.

Elara later dialogues:
- if m1 done && !nima_met: "Ve al Bosque de las Voces... Nima".
- if gem_taken: "La Gema canta... Drakmor".
- if truth: "El Velo...".
- default.

Marta:
- shop choice effect `{type:'shop',id:'marta'}`; side quest choice.
- If s1 active: dialogue "¿Tienes mis hierbas?" if inventory >=3 maybe complete via talk event. Quest step 1 talk marta; game.questEvent('talk','marta') on open will complete if step 1. EndEffect give reward handled by quest completion. So dialogue should check s1 state and respond.
- Accept s1 effect startQuest.
- endEffect none.

Bron: shop/forge.

Lía: hints.

Guard: hints about forest/ruins.

Farmer: flavor, hint herbs.

Kael: side quest s2. Also hints about creatures/capture.
- if s2 inactive: dialogue with choice accept.
- if s2 active step 0: hint.
- if step 1: thanks, complete via talk.
Nima:
- if !nima_met: main dialogue, start m2, flag nima_met.
- if m2 active: hints about ruins/guardian; maybe teach capture.
- if gem_taken: Drakmor.
Cael: s4 quest.
Ordo: s3 + m3 start.
Serah: m3 progression/forge/shop.
Citizen, merchant.
Archivista: m4/trial + s5.

Let's write.

Need `QUEST` references in dialogues: `startQuest` effects. We'll define quests later.

`elara_blessing` effect: game handles give sword_alba, add creature lumito, learn spell filo_luz, flag sword_given, xp 40, toast.

`forge_tear` effect: game handles upgrade sword to celestial, learn ola_resonante, flag tear_forged, complete m3, scene truth? Actually forging scene cinematic `forge` maybe. Add cinematic `forge_tear`? We'll include in cinematics. Effect can trigger scene `forge_tear` and then complete quest. We'll implement game effect with sequence.

`read_truth` handled by altar object, not NPC.

Ordo `m3_started` flag.

Side quest starts.

Let's write part 3.

Now quests, lore, cinematics, endings. Replace marker.

Quests structure. Let's write.

Main quests:
m1:
- state initially set by game to active.
- steps:
0 talk elara, marker village elara.
1 interact shrine_village, marker.
rewards xp 80, gold 40, items potion_lumen x2.
onComplete flags m1_done.
m2:
0 talk nima (started by Nima dialogue, event talk nima -> immediately advance? Actually startQuest sets step 0; game then questEvent talk nima called before or after effect? Game will call questEvent('talk', npcId) when dialogue opens, before endEffect starts quest. So startQuest m2 occurs on close, step 0 remains "Habla con Nima" but already talked. Bad. We should start m2 at step 0 = "Llega a las Ruinas de Alderion" or have effect startQuest with `step:1`. Simpler: m2 starts at step 0 "Cruza la niebla y llega a las Ruinas" (event reach zone ruins), then step 1 kill boss guardian, step 2 altar gem. Nima dialogue starts quest with first step reach ruins. Good.
- m2 steps:
0 reach zone valdoria_ruins
1 kill boss_guardian
2 interact altar_gem
rewards.
m3:
0 talk ordo (but startQuest on dialogue close, after talk event; set step 0 = "Habla con Serah en Cindral" to avoid). Or start quest before dialogue? We can have `startQuest` effect on choice within dialogue before close, then talk event already processed. Set m3 step 0 "Llega a Cindral y habla con Serah", event talk serah. Then step 1 kill reina, step 2 talk serah (forge). That works.
m4 starts on temple trigger with step 0 trial altars (event trial_done count? use event type 'trial' id 'trial_done'). Then step 1 kill custodio, step 2 altar truth.
m5 starts on void trigger step 0 kill arquitecto, step 1 altar convergence.
Main quest completion flags:
m1_done, m2_done, gem_taken, m3_done, tear_forged, m4_done, truth_known, m5_done.
Quest completion effects handled by `onComplete` object in quest data:
```
onComplete:{flags:{...}, items:[...], spells:[...], unlock...}
```
Game applies.

s1 steps:
0 collect herb_brisa count 3 (marker meadow)
1 talk marta.
s2:
0 interact lost_echo (marker forest)
1 talk kael.
s3:
0 kill tag drakmor count 5
1 talk ordo.
s4:
0 collect crystal_shard count 3
1 interact bell_ruins
2 talk cael.
s5:
0 collect star_shard count 3
1 talk archivista.

Kill events: game will call questEvent('kill', {enemy, region, tag, elite}). We need match. For s3 event `{type:'kill', tag:'drakmor', count:5}`. Game passes region. For boss quest event `{type:'kill', boss:'guardian_raiz'}` or use `questEvent` from boss defeat with type 'boss', id. Let's define steps with `event:{type:'boss', id:'guardian_raiz'}`. Game calls questEvent('boss', enemyId) on boss defeat. Good.

m2 step 1 boss guardian_raiz. m3 boss reina_calcinada. m4 boss custodio_velo. m5 boss arquitecto.

m1 step 1 interact shrine_village.
m2 step 2 interact altar_gem.

 {id:'seal', title:'Sellar el Velo', desc:'...', req:null},

## Objective
- Build "LA ESPADA CELESTIAL", a real, playable, deep, original fantasy action RPG for Android/browser with cinematic anime-inspired art, Spanish (Spain) text, three regions, customizable protagonist, action combat, creature collection, story, quests, equipment, skills, save/load, touch controls, accessibility, and GOTY-level ambition.
- Deliver a working game in the existing OMGithub static-browser-game environment, not a mockup, design bible, or demo.

## Requirements
- Horizontal orientation; Android priority; Spanish (Spain).
- Real gameplay: exploration, combat, story, characters, world, creatures, UI, AI, music/SFX, animation, performance, accessibility.
- Original IP only; no copying existing characters, music, stories, or designs.
- Protagonist customization: name, face, hair, hair color, clothes, armor, helmet, accessories, weapons.
- Stats: Vida, Maná, Resistencia, Fuerza, Defensa, Velocidad, Inteligencia, Suerte, each with measurable effects.
- Equipment must change stats and, where possible, appearance.
- Distinct animations for idle, walk, run, attack, dodge, block, hurt, etc.
- Three regions: Valdoria, Drakmor, Kansordore.
- Story elements required: Gema Celestial, Jarra de Origen, Lágrima de la Primera Brasa, Profecía de Jugador Cero, Convergencia Absoluta, El Despertar, La Resonancia, El Velo, La Ruptura, La Ascensión.
- Do not claim GOTY has been won or is deserved; it is an excellence target only.
- If platform limitations exist, explain them and implement the best technical alternative.
- User prompt was truncated mid-sentence after "Crear animaciones diferenciadas de reposo, caminar, correr, atacar, esquivar, bloquear, recibi…"; infer remaining expected systems from the overall brief.

## Decisions
- Build a browser-based 2D top-down action RPG using HTML5 Canvas 2D + DOM UI, not Three.js/3D, for reliable mobile performance and complete playability without external assets.
- Static site with ES modules; no bundler required. `start.sh`/OMGithub default static server will serve `index.html`.
- Procedural original art (terrain, props, characters, creatures, effects) and procedural WebAudio music/SFX; local OFL fonts downloaded to `assets/fonts/`.
- Architecture: `src/core.js`, `src/data.js`, `src/story.js`, `src/world.js`, `src/entities.js`, `src/render.js`, plus planned `src/ui.js` and `src/game.js`/`main.js`.
- Combat is real-time with light combo, heavy, dodge i-frames, block/parry, 3 spells, potion, creature companion skill, stamina/mana, statuses, telegraphs, bosses with phases.
- Creature capture occurs at ≤35% HP while staggered; companion fights alongside player; codex/party planned.
- Save system uses 3 localStorage slots; autosave planned.
- UI/UX uses canvas for world, DOM overlays for HUD/menus/dialogue/cinematics; mobile virtual joystick + 8 action buttons.
- Testing will use `playwright-cli` with the preinstalled Chromium/SwiftShader setup and screenshots; must inspect actual gameplay, not blank/loading screens.
- Need to remain honest in README/credits that GOTY is an aspiration, not an achievement.

### Completed

- Downloaded local fonts: `assets/fonts/cinzel-latin.woff2`, `alegreya-400.woff2`, `alegreya-500.woff2`, `alegreya-700.woff2`, `alegreya-italic.woff2`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build "LA ESPADA CELESTIAL", a real, playable, deep, original fantasy action RPG for Android/browser with cinematic anime-inspired art, Spanish (Spain) text, three regions, customizable protagonist, action combat, creature collection, story, quests, equipment, skills, save/load, touch controls, accessibility, and GOTY-level ambition.
- Deliver a working game in the existing OMGithub static-browser-game environment, not a mockup, design bible, or demo.

## Requirements
- Horizontal orientation; Android priority; Spanish (Spain).
- Real gameplay: exploration, combat, story, characters, world, creatures, UI, AI, music/SFX, animation, performance, accessibility.
- Original IP only; no copying existing characters, music, stories, or designs.
- Protagonist customization: name, face, hair, hair color, clothes, armor, helmet, accessories, weapons.
- Stats: Vida, Maná, Resistencia, Fuerza, Defensa, Velocidad, Inteligencia, Suerte, each with measurable effects.
- Equipment must change stats and, where possible, appearance.
- Distinct animations for idle, walk, run, attack, dodge, block, hurt, etc.
- Three regions: Valdoria, Drakmor, Kansordore.
- Story elements required: Gema Celestial, Jarra de Origen, Lágrima de la Primera Brasa, Profecía de Jugador Cero, Convergencia Absoluta, El Despertar, La Resonancia, El Velo, La Ruptura, La Ascensión.
- Do not claim GOTY has been won or is deserved; it is an excellence target only.
- If platform limitations exist, explain them and implement the best technical alternative.
- User prompt was truncated mid-sentence after "Crear animaciones diferenciadas de reposo, caminar, correr, atacar, esquivar, bloquear, recibi…"; infer remaining expected systems from the overall brief.

## Decisions
- Build a browser-based 2D top-down action RPG using HTML5 Canvas 2D + DOM UI, not Three.js/3D, for reliable mobile performance and complete playability without external assets.
- Static site with ES modules; no bundler required. `start.sh`/OMGithub default static server will serve `index.html`.
- Procedural original art (terrain, props, characters, creatures, effects) and procedural WebAudio music/SFX; local OFL fonts downloaded to `assets/fonts/`.
- Split procedural art into modules to stay under write-tool limits: `src/art.js` (helpers/humanoids/creatures), `src/art_world.js` (props/buildings), `src/art_ui.js` (portraits/preview/title/cinematics), `src/art_map.js` (minimap/zone/world maps).
- Combat is real-time with light combo, heavy, dodge i-frames, block/parry, 3 spells, potion, creature companion skill, stamina/mana, statuses, telegraphs, bosses with phases.
- Creature capture occurs at ≤35% HP while staggered; companion fights alongside player; codex/party planned.
- Save system uses 3 localStorage slots; autosave planned.
- UI/UX uses canvas for world, DOM overlays for HUD/menus/dialogue/cinematics; mobile virtual joystick + 8 action buttons.
- Testing will use `playwright-cli` with the preinstalled Chromium/SwiftShader setup and screenshots; must inspect actual gameplay, not blank/loading screens.
- Need to remain honest in README/credits that GOTY is an aspiration, not an achievement.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected repository: essentially empty OMGithub scaffold; Node 24, npm 11, `playwright-cli`, tmux, internet, and static server runtime available.
- Downloaded local fonts: `assets/fonts/cinzel-latin.woff2`, `alegreya-400.woff2`, `alegreya-500.woff2`, `alegreya-700.woff2`, `alegreya-italic.woff2`.
- Created `index.html` with canvas, HUD, touch controls, title screen, character creation screen, overlay, dialogue layer, cinematic layer, toasts/banner/fade/boot/rotate hint.
- Created comprehensive `styles.css` for all screens, HUD, touch controls, menus, dialogue, cinematics, responsive/mobile layouts.
- Created `src/core.js`: math utils, seeded RNG, `ELEMENTS`, `STAT_KEYS`, `Input`, procedural `AudioEngine` (music moods/SFX), `SaveSystem`, `QUALITY`, `detectQuality`.
- Created `src/data.js`: appearance options, portraits, rarity, full item catalog, shops, skill tree (18 nodes), spells, 18 creatures with abilities/lore, 15 enemies including 5 bosses, helper getters.
- Created `src/story.js`: 3 regions, all 10 zone definitions with paths/buildings/NPCs/enemies/chests/shrines/portals/lore/objects/bosses/triggers; 14 NPC dialogue trees; 10 quests (5 main, 5 side); 19 lore entries; 14 cinematics; 3 final choices/endings; loot tables; zone ordering.
- Created `src/world.js`: `Zone`/`World` classes, deterministic scatter, collision grid, water/lava/building collision, bridges, interactables, NPC/enemy/chest/shrine/portal/lore/herb/object building, nearest interactable.
- Created `src/entities.js`: `Player` (stats/equipment/skills/combat state machine/dodge/block/cast/regen/statuses), `Enemy` (normal/elite/boss AI, patterns, phases, statuses, poise/stagger, capture eligibility), `Companion`, `Projectile`.
- Created `src/render.js` through background cache, water/lava animation, drawable sorting, and main `render()` scaffolding; file ends with `// __RENDER2__` and class closing brace, with many renderer methods still undefined.
- Created `src/art.js`: exported `rr`, `glow`, `shadow`, `poly`, `mix`, `appearancePalette`, `drawHumanoid`, `drawCreatureShape`, `drawCreature`; includes procedural player/NPC humanoid animation states and all creature/enemy silhouettes.
- Created `src/art_world.js`: exported `drawProp`, `drawBuilding`; covers well, market, cart, anvil, tent, campfire, brazier, statue, pillar, arch, shelf, throne, dais, lamp, fence, scarecrow, log, mushroom ring, crystals, obsidian, skull, lava fall, floating rock, star, banner, bench, bridge, windmill, stone circle, rune circle, bell, candle, and building styles.
- Created `src/art_ui.js`: exported `drawPortrait`, `drawPreview`, `drawTitleArt`, `drawCinematicArt`; includes creature portraits, animated character busts, creation preview, title key art, and cinematic art for all story `art` IDs.
- Created `src/art_map.js`: exported `drawMinimap`, `drawZoneMap`, `drawWorldMap`; includes paths/water/lava/buildings, markers, player arrow, region layout, connections, legend, compass.
- Fixed an invalid color-string expression in `src/art_world.js` crystal drawing.

### Active
- Completing `src/render.js` by appending all referenced methods and wiring imports from `art.js`, `art_world.js`, `art_ui.js`, `art_map.js`.
- Still need `src/ui.js`, `src/game.js`, `src/main.js`, `manifest.webmanifest`, `assets/icon.svg`, README.
- No integration/testing of game loop yet.

### Blocked
- None technically; main risk is scope/time and finishing all renderer methods + UI/game integration coherently.

## Next Move
1. Append missing methods to `src/render.js`: `_drawBuilding`, `_drawProp`, `_drawObject`, `_drawChest`, `_drawShrine`, `_drawLoreStone`, `_drawHerb`, `_drawPortal`, `_drawNPC`, `_drawEnemy`, `_drawCompanion`, `_drawPlayer`, `_drawLoot`, `_drawProjectiles`, `_drawEffects`, `_drawParticles`, `_drawFloatingTexts`, `_drawAmbient`, `_drawScreenOverlays`, plus title/cinematic/portrait/creature/minimap/world-map/preview wrappers.
2. Create `src/ui.js`: title/continue/save slots, character creation, HUD updates, touch controls, pause/menu tabs (character, equipment, inventory, skills, creatures, quests, map, options), dialogue typewriter/choices, cinematic player, toasts/banners, shop/forge.
3. Create `src/game.js`: `Game` state machine, loop, zone transitions, combat hit resolution, spells, capture, loot/XP/leveling, quest events/rewards, NPC interaction/effects, story triggers, boss encounters, save/load, endings, debug API (`window.__GAME__`).
4. Create `src/main.js` bootstrapping renderer/input/audio/UI/game and title screen animation; add `manifest.webmanifest`, `assets/icon.svg`, README.
5. Run `node --check` on all JS; start server via tmux (`PORT=3002 node /home/runner/work/_temp/omgithub-runtime/scripts/default-start.mjs`); use `playwright-cli` to screenshot title, creation, gameplay, combat, menus, mobile landscape; inspect and iterate.
6. Verify real functionality end-to-end (new game → Elara → shrine → forest → ruins boss → Drakmor → Kansordore → ending), save/load, touch controls, no console errors.

- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/game.js`: not yet created; core game state/combat/quest/save logic.

## Objective
- Build "LA ESPADA CELESTIAL", a real, playable, deep, original fantasy action RPG for Android/browser with cinematic anime-inspired art, Spanish (Spain) text, three regions, customizable protagonist, action combat, creature collection, story, quests, equipment, skills, save/load, touch controls, accessibility, and GOTY-level ambition.
- Deliver a working game in the existing OMGithub static-browser-game environment, not a mockup, design bible, or demo.

## Requirements
- Horizontal orientation; Android priority; Spanish (Spain).
- Real gameplay: exploration, combat, story, characters, world, creatures, UI, AI, music/SFX, animation, performance, accessibility.
- Original IP only; no copying existing characters, music, stories, or designs.
- Protagonist customization: name, face, hair, hair color, clothes, armor, helmet, accessories, weapons.
- Stats: Vida, Maná, Resistencia, Fuerza, Defensa, Velocidad, Inteligencia, Suerte, each with measurable effects.
- Equipment must change stats and, where possible, appearance.
- Distinct animations for idle, walk, run, attack, dodge, block, hurt, etc.
- Three regions: Valdoria, Drakmor, Kansordore.
- Story elements required: Gema Celestial, Jarra de Origen, Lágrima de la Primera Brasa, Profecía de Jugador Cero, Convergencia Absoluta, El Despertar, La Resonancia, El Velo, La Ruptura, La Ascensión.
- Do not claim GOTY has been won or is deserved; it is an excellence target only.
- If platform limitations exist, explain them and implement the best technical alternative.
- User prompt was truncated mid-sentence after "Crear animaciones diferenciadas de reposo, caminar, correr, atacar, esquivar, bloquear, recibi…"; infer remaining expected systems from the overall brief.

## Decisions
- Build a browser-based 2D top-down action RPG using HTML5 Canvas 2D + DOM UI, not Three.js/3D, for reliable mobile performance and complete playability without external assets.
- Static site with ES modules; no bundler required. `start.sh`/OMGithub default static server will serve `index.html`.
- Procedural original art (terrain, props, characters, creatures, effects) and procedural WebAudio music/SFX; local OFL fonts downloaded to `assets/fonts/`.
- Split procedural art into modules to stay under write-tool limits: `src/art.js` (helpers/humanoids/creatures), `src/art_world.js` (props/buildings), `src/art_ui.js` (portraits/preview/title/cinematics), `src/art_map.js` (minimap/zone/world maps).
- Combat is real-time with light combo, heavy, dodge i-frames, block/parry, 3 spells, potion, creature companion skill, stamina/mana, statuses, telegraphs, bosses with phases.
- Creature capture occurs at ≤35% HP while staggered; companion fights alongside player; codex/party planned.
- Save system uses 3 localStorage slots; autosave planned.
- UI/UX uses canvas for world, DOM overlays for HUD/menus/dialogue/cinematics; mobile virtual joystick + 8 action buttons.
- Testing will use `playwright-cli` with the preinstalled Chromium/SwiftShader setup and screenshots; must inspect actual gameplay, not blank/loading screens.
- Need to remain honest in README/credits that GOTY is an aspiration, not an achievement.
- Game architecture now implemented around `Game` state machine, `UI` DOM controller, renderer, world, entities, story/data, and procedural audio.
- Final ending "break" requires ≥8 captured creatures + `truth_known`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected repository: essentially empty OMGithub scaffold; Node 24, npm 11, `playwright-cli`, tmux, internet, and static server runtime available.
- Downloaded local fonts: `assets/fonts/cinzel-latin.woff2`, `alegreya-400.woff2`, `alegreya-500.woff2`, `alegreya-700.woff2`, `alegreya-italic.woff2`.
- Created `index.html` with canvas, HUD, touch controls, title screen, character creation screen, overlay, dialogue layer, cinematic layer, toasts/banner/fade/boot/rotate hint.
- Created comprehensive `styles.css` for all screens, HUD, touch controls, menus, dialogue, cinematics, responsive/mobile layouts.
- Created `src/core.js`: math utils, seeded RNG, `ELEMENTS`, `STAT_KEYS`, `Input`, procedural `AudioEngine`, `SaveSystem`, `QUALITY`, `detectQuality`.
- Created `src/data.js`: appearance options, portraits, rarity, full item catalog, shops, skill tree (18 nodes), spells, 18 creatures with abilities/lore, 15 enemies including 5 bosses, helper getters.
- Created `src/story.js`: 3 regions, all 10 zone definitions with paths/buildings/NPCs/enemies/chests/shrines/portals/lore/objects/bosses/triggers; 14 NPC dialogue trees; 10 quests (5 main, 5 side); 19 lore entries; 14 cinematics; 3 final choices/endings; loot tables; zone ordering.
- Created `src/world.js`: `Zone`/`World` classes, deterministic scatter, collision grid, water/lava/building collision, bridges, interactables, NPC/enemy/chest/shrine/portal/lore/herb/object building, nearest interactable.
- Created `src/entities.js`: `Player` (stats/equipment/skills/combat state machine/dodge/block/cast/regen/statuses), `Enemy` (normal/elite/boss AI, patterns, phases, statuses, poise/stagger, capture eligibility), `Companion`, `Projectile`.
- Created `src/render.js` through background cache, water/lava animation, drawable sorting, main `render()` scaffolding; appended all missing methods: `_drawBuilding`, `_drawProp`, `_drawObject`, `_drawChest`, `_drawShrine`, `_drawLoreStone`, `_drawHerb`, `_drawPortal`, `_drawNPC`, `_drawEnemy`, `_drawCompanion`, `_drawPlayer`, `_drawLoot`, `_drawProjectiles`, `_drawEffects`, `_drawParticles`, `_drawFloatingTexts`, `_drawAmbient`, `_drawScreenOverlays`, plus title/cinematic/portrait/preview/minimap/world-map wrappers; wired imports from all art modules.
- Created `src/art.js`: exported `rr`, `glow`, `shadow`, `poly`, `mix`, `appearancePalette`, `drawHumanoid`, `drawCreatureShape`, `drawCreature`; includes procedural player/NPC humanoid animation states and all creature/enemy silhouettes.
- Created `src/art_world.js`: exported `drawProp`, `drawBuilding`; covers well, market, cart, anvil, tent, campfire, brazier, statue, pillar, arch, shelf, throne, dais, lamp, fence, scarecrow, log, mushroom ring, crystals, obsidian, skull, lava fall, floating rock, star, banner, bench, bridge, windmill, stone circle, rune circle, bell, candle, and building styles.
- Created `src/art_ui.js`: exported `drawPortrait`, `drawPreview`, `drawTitleArt`, `drawCinematicArt`; includes creature portraits, animated character busts, creation preview, title key art, and cinematic art for all story `art` IDs.
- Created `src/art_map.js`: exported `drawMinimap`, `drawZoneMap`, `drawWorldMap`; includes paths/water/lava/buildings, markers, player arrow, region layout, connections, legend, compass.
- Fixed an invalid color-string expression in `src/art_world.js` crystal drawing.
- Created `src/game.js`: full `Game` class with loop updates, input handling, zones/travel, boss encounters/phases, interactions, dialogue effects, combat, spells, capture, loot/XP/gold/leveling, quest progression, NPC quest markers, forge/upgrades, shops, skills, attribute spending, endings, 3-slot save/load/autosave, settings, effects/particles/text, death/respawn.

### Active
- Still need `src/ui.js`, `src/main.js`, `manifest.webmanifest`, `assets/icon.svg`, README.
- Need modify `Player.recalc` to include `game.itemUpgradeBonus(itemId, key)` for forge upgrades.
- No integration/testing of game loop yet.

### Blocked
- None technically; main risk is scope/time and finishing UI/main integration coherently.

## Next Move
1. Create `src/ui.js`: title/continue/save slots, character creation, HUD updates, touch controls, pause/menu tabs (character, equipment, inventory, skills, creatures, quests, map, options), dialogue typewriter/choices, cinematic player, toasts/banners, shop/forge, death/ending, lore, credits.
2. Create `src/main.js`: bootstrap renderer/input/audio/UI/game, title animation loop, global frame loop, boot/orientation handling, audio unlock.
3. Edit `src/entities.js` `Player.recalc` to add forge bonus via `game.itemUpgradeBonus`.
4. Add `manifest.webmanifest`, `assets/icon.svg`, README with honest GOTY/aspiration note and Android/browser instructions.
5. Run `node --check` on all JS; start server via tmux (`PORT=3002 node /home/runner/work/_temp/omgithub-runtime/scripts/default-start.mjs`); use `playwright-cli` to screenshot title, creation, gameplay, combat, menus, mobile landscape; inspect and iterate.
6. Verify real functionality end-to-end (new game → Elara → shrine → forest → ruins boss → Drakmor → Kansordore → ending), save/load, touch controls, no console errors.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/game.js`: complete game logic; UI must satisfy its calls (`enterGame`, `updateHUD`, `openMenu`, `openDialogue`, `playCinematic`, `openShop`, `openForge`, `openLore`, `showEndingChoices`, `playEnding`, `showDeath`, `showBanner`, `toast`, `fade`, `updatePrompts`, `updateContinue`, `refreshMenu`, `closeOverlay`).
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/ui.js`: not yet created; DOM UI/menus/dialogue/cinematics/touch.

## Important Context
- Repo is on branch `opencode/41239122622`; all files are currently untracked/uncommitted. No commit/push yet.

## Objective
- Build "LA ESPADA CELESTIAL", a real, playable, deep, original fantasy action RPG for Android/browser with cinematic anime-inspired art, Spanish (Spain) text, three regions, customizable protagonist, action combat, creature collection, story, quests, equipment, skills, save/load, touch controls, accessibility, and GOTY-level ambition.
- Deliver a working game in the existing OMGithub static-browser-game environment, not a mockup, design bible, or demo.

## Requirements
- Horizontal orientation; Android priority; Spanish (Spain).
- Real gameplay: exploration, combat, story, characters, world, creatures, UI, AI, music/SFX, animation, performance, accessibility.
- Original IP only; no copying existing characters, music, stories, or designs.
- Protagonist customization: name, face, hair, hair color, clothes, armor, helmet, accessories, weapons.
- Stats: Vida, Maná, Resistencia, Fuerza, Defensa, Velocidad, Inteligencia, Suerte, each with measurable effects.
- Equipment must change stats and, where possible, appearance.
- Distinct animations for idle, walk, run, attack, dodge, block, hurt, etc.
- Three regions: Valdoria, Drakmor, Kansordore.
- Story elements required: Gema Celestial, Jarra de Origen, Lágrima de la Primera Brasa, Profecía de Jugador Cero, Convergencia Absoluta, El Despertar, La Resonancia, El Velo, La Ruptura, La Ascensión.
- Do not claim GOTY has been won or is deserved; it is an excellence target only.
- If platform limitations exist, explain them and implement the best technical alternative.
- User prompt was truncated mid-sentence after "Crear animaciones diferenciadas de reposo, caminar, correr, atacar, esquivar, bloquear, recibi…"; infer remaining expected systems from the overall brief.

## Decisions
- Build a browser-based 2D top-down action RPG using HTML5 Canvas 2D + DOM UI, not Three.js/3D, for reliable mobile performance and complete playability without external assets.
- Static site with ES modules; no bundler required. `start.sh`/OMGithub default static server will serve `index.html`.

import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'
import { resolve, join, extname } from 'node:path'
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { createServer } from 'node:http'
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'
import { child } from './session-lifecycle.mjs'
import { livePreviewScript, watchProject } from './live-preview.mjs'

export function projectType(root) {
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'package.json'))) {
    const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))
    if (p.dependencies?.next || p.devDependencies?.next) throw new Error('Unsupported framework: customize start.sh and provide static deployment output.')
    if (p.dependencies?.vite || p.devDependencies?.vite) return 'vite'
    throw new Error('Unsupported package project: customize start.sh and deployment output.')
  }
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) return 'html'
  throw new Error('No generated index.html or supported package project.')
}
export async function start(root = process.cwd()) {
  const type = projectType(root)
  const projectRoot = resolve(root)
  if (type === 'vite') {
    const stampDir = process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR || join(root, 'node_modules', '.cache')
    mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
    const stamp = join(stampDir, 'default-dependencies')
    const lock = join(root, 'package-lock.json')
    const hash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
    let old = ''
    try { old = readFileSync(stamp, 'utf8') } catch {}
    if (old !== hash || !existsSync(join(root, 'node_modules/vite'))) {
      await child('npm', [existsSync(lock) ? 'ci' : 'install', '--no-audit', '--no-fund'], { cwd: root })
      mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
      const installedHash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
      writeFileSync(stamp, installedHash)
    }
    await child(process.execPath, [join(root, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './'], { cwd: root })
    root = join(root, 'dist')
  }
  if (!existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) throw new Error('Static deployment output must contain index.html.')
  if (process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR) writeFileSync(join(process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR, 'deployment-output.json'), JSON.stringify({ project: projectRoot, directory: resolve(root) }))
  const mime = { '.html':'text/html', '.js':'application/javascript', '.css':'text/css', '.json':'application/json', '.svg':'image/svg+xml', '.png':'image/png', '.jpg':'image/jpeg', '.webp':'image/webp', '.wasm':'application/wasm', '.glb':'model/gltf-binary' }
  const clients = new Set()
  const stopWatching = watchProject(root, () => { for (const client of clients) client.write('event: change\ndata: changed\n\n') })
  const keepAlive = setInterval(() => { for (const client of clients) client.write(': keepalive\n\n') }, 20000)
  const buildWatcher = type === 'vite' ? spawn(process.execPath, [join(projectRoot, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './', '--watch'], { cwd: projectRoot, stdio: 'inherit' }) : null
  const server = createServer((req, res) => {
    try {
      const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost')
      if (url.pathname === '/__omgithub/live') {
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream', 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache', 'X-Accel-Buffering': 'no', Connection: 'keep-alive' })
        res.write(': connected\n\n')
        clients.add(res)
        req.on('close', () => clients.delete(res))
        return
      }
      const path = resolve(root, '.' + decodeURIComponent(url.pathname))
      if (path !== resolve(root) && !path.startsWith(resolve(root) + '/')) { res.writeHead(404); res.end(); return }
      const file = statSync(path).isDirectory() ? join(path, 'index.html') : path
      res.setHeader('Content-Type', mime[extname(file)] || 'application/octet-stream')

"LA ESPADA CELESTIAL
ENCARGO MAESTRO DEFINITIVO PARA IA GAME LAB
RPG DE FANTASÍA ÉPICA — OBJETIVO: ASPIRAR A GOTY
INSTRUCCIÓN PRINCIPAL:
Quiero que desarrolles LA ESPADA CELESTIAL, un videojuego RPG de fantasía medieval, acción, aventura, exploración y criaturas coleccionables. No quiero una simple demostración, una maqueta, una presentación, una biblia de diseño ni un escenario con botones decorativos. Quiero un videojuego real, jugable, funcional, profundo, original y profesional.
La ambición es crear un título capaz de competir algún día entre los mejores videojuegos del mundo y aspirar al premio GOTY (Game of the Year).
No afirmes que el juego ha ganado o merece un premio sin haberlo conseguido. El GOTY es nuestro objetivo de excelencia, no una promesa.
Debes trabajar sobre las capacidades reales de IA Game Lab, inspeccionar el proyecto existente y utilizar las herramientas disponibles para construir el juego. No inventes funciones que la plataforma no pueda ejecutar. Si algo no es posible, explica la limitación y desarrolla la mejor alternativa técnica.
---
1. IDENTIDAD DEL VIDEOJUEGO
Nombre: LA ESPADA CELESTIAL.
Género: RPG de acción, fantasía medieval, aventura, exploración, combate y colección de criaturas.
Plataforma prioritaria: Android.
Orientación: Horizontal.
Idioma: Español de España.
Estética: Fantasía medieval cinematográfica con personalidad anime, escenarios detallados, iluminación espectacular, personajes originales y efectos visuales de alta calidad.
Inspiración: La profundidad de los grandes RPG, la libertad de exploración de las aventuras clásicas y la emoción de coleccionar criaturas, sin copiar personajes, diseños, música, historias ni propiedades intelectuales existentes.
El juego debe tener identidad propia y ser reconocible por su universo, personajes, criaturas, música y dirección artística.
---
2. OBJETIVO DE CALIDAD: NIVEL GOTY
Diseña y desarrolla el juego siguiendo estándares de excelencia en:
Jugabilidad.
Combate.
Historia.
Personajes.
Mundo.
Exploración.
Diseño artístico.
Música y sonido.
Animaciones.
Inteligencia artificial.
Interfaz y controles.
Rendimiento.
Accesibilidad.
Profundidad de sistemas.
Originalidad.
Cada sistema debe aportar algo al conjunto.
No quiero cantidad sin calidad.
No quiero un mundo enorme vacío, enemigos repetidos, misiones genéricas ni habilidades que no tengan utilidad.
Quiero una experiencia memorable.
---
3. UNIVERSO E HISTORIA
El mundo está formado por regiones conectadas por una historia épica.
Región inicial: VALDORIA
Una tierra de aldeas, bosques, praderas, ríos, montañas, ruinas y antiguas civilizaciones.
Aquí comienza la aventura.
Región de DRAKMOR
Territorios volcánicos, fortalezas, ciudades devastadas, bosques oscuros y criaturas corrompidas.
Región de KANSORDORE
Templos celestiales, ciudades antiguas, bibliotecas prohibidas, dimensiones alternativas y misterios relacionados con el origen del mundo.
Elementos fundamentales de la historia
La Gema Celestial.
La Jarra de Origen.
La Lágrima de la Primera Brasa.
La Profecía de Jugador Cero.
La Convergencia Absoluta.
El Despertar.
La Resonancia.
El Velo.
La Ruptura.
La Ascensión.
Construye una historia original, coherente y emocionante, con misterios, revelaciones, conflictos, decisiones, consecuencias, personajes memorables y un final satisfactorio.
No reveles todos los misterios al principio.
La historia debe desarrollarse mediante acontecimientos jugables, diálogos, exploración y escenas cinematográficas.
---
4. PROTAGONISTA
Crear un protagonista personalizable.

RPG DE FANTASÍA ÉPICA — OBJETIVO: ASPIRAR A GOTY
INSTRUCCIÓN PRINCIPAL:
Quiero que desarrolles LA ESPADA CELESTIAL, un videojuego RPG de fantasía medieval, acción, aventura, exploración y criaturas coleccionables. No quiero una simple demostración, una maqueta, una presentación, una biblia de diseño ni un escenario con botones decorativos. Quiero un videojuego real, jugable, funcional, profundo, original y profesional.
La ambición es crear un título capaz de competir algún día entre los mejores videojuegos del mundo y aspirar al premio GOTY (Game of the Year).
No afirmes que el juego ha ganado o merece un premio sin haberlo conseguido. El GOTY es nuestro objetivo de excelencia, no una promesa.
Debes trabajar sobre las capacidades reales de IA Game Lab, inspeccionar el proyecto existente y utilizar las herramientas disponibles para construir el juego. No inventes funciones que la plataforma no pueda ejecutar. Si algo no es posible, explica la limitación y desarrolla la mejor alternativa técnica.
---
1. IDENTIDAD DEL VIDEOJUEGO
Nombre: LA ESPADA CELESTIAL.
Género: RPG de acción, fantasía medieval, aventura, exploración, combate y colección de criaturas.
Plataforma prioritaria: Android.
Orientación: Horizontal.
Idioma: Español de España.
Estética: Fantasía medieval cinematográfica con personalidad anime, escenarios detallados, iluminación espectacular, personajes originales y efectos visuales de alta calidad.
Inspiración: La profundidad de los grandes RPG, la libertad de exploración de las aventuras clásicas y la emoción de coleccionar criaturas, sin copiar personajes, diseños, música, historias ni propiedades intelectuales existentes.
El juego debe tener identidad propia y ser reconocible por su universo, personajes, criaturas, música y dirección artística.
---
2. OBJETIVO DE CALIDAD: NIVEL GOTY
Diseña y desarrolla el juego siguiendo estándares de excelencia en:
Jugabilidad.
Combate.
Historia.
Personajes.
Mundo.
Exploración.
Diseño artístico.
Música y sonido.
Animaciones.
Inteligencia artificial.
Interfaz y controles.
Rendimiento.
Accesibilidad.
Profundidad de sistemas.
Originalidad.
Cada sistema debe aportar algo al conjunto.
No quiero cantidad sin calidad.
No quiero un mundo enorme vacío, enemigos repetidos, misiones genéricas ni habilidades que no tengan utilidad.
Quiero una experiencia memorable.
---
3. UNIVERSO E HISTORIA
El mundo está formado por regiones conectadas por una historia épica.
Región inicial: VALDORIA
Una tierra de aldeas, bosques, praderas, ríos, montañas, ruinas y antiguas civilizaciones.
Aquí comienza la aventura.
Región de DRAKMOR
Territorios volcánicos, fortalezas, ciudades devastadas, bosques oscuros y criaturas corrompidas.
Región de KANSORDORE
Templos celestiales, ciudades antiguas, bibliotecas prohibidas, dimensiones alternativas y misterios relacionados con el origen del mundo.
Elementos fundamentales de la historia
La Gema Celestial.
La Jarra de Origen.
La Lágrima de la Primera Brasa.
La Profecía de Jugador Cero.
La Convergencia Absoluta.
El Despertar.
La Resonancia.
El Velo.
La Ruptura.
La Ascensión.
Construye una historia original, coherente y emocionante, con misterios, revelaciones, conflictos, decisiones, consecuencias, personajes memorables y un final satisfactorio.
No reveles todos los misterios al principio.
La historia debe desarrollarse mediante acontecimientos jugables, diálogos, exploración y escenas cinematográficas.
---
4. PROTAGONISTA
Crear un protagonista personalizable.
Permitir configurar, según las posibilidades técnicas:
Nombre.
Rostro.
Pelo.
Color de pelo.
Ropa.
Armadura.
Casco.
Accesorios.
Armas.
Estadísticas
Vida.
Maná.
Resistencia.
Fuerza.
Defensa.
Velocidad.
Inteligencia.
Suerte.
Cada atributo debe tener efectos medibles.
El equipamiento debe modificar las estadísticas y, cuando sea viable, la apariencia del personaje.
Crear animaciones diferenciadas de reposo, caminar, correr, atacar, esquivar, bloquear, recibi
"
